title: Aniraku May Go Dark Before Oct 20
message: Our backend credits are almost finished — once they run out, streaming stops and Aniraku goes offline. We run a huge anime library that keeps growing on your demand: want an anime added? Mail us at sho.islam0311@proton.me and we will add it. I come from a middle-class family and cannot pay for the servers from my own pocket — if you want Aniraku to stay available, please donate. Every contribution keeps the episodes playing.
